summary: Billing S3 source credentials rotated to a wrong value outside Terraform; sync failed in source discovery; repaired by re-importing the source into Terraform state and applying the billing targets; rerun green; bronze counts unchanged.

break.detail: Airbyte Cloud UI runs a connection test on save and offers no save-anyway, so the wrong secret could not be saved from the UI. Applied with PATCH /v1/sources/{id}. The masked aws_access_key_id returned by GET was echoed back and stored literally, so the failure surfaced as InvalidAccessKeyId.

failed_job.ui_failure_reason: Failure in source: Checking source connection failed - please review this connection's configuration to prevent future syncs from failing
failed_job.log_evidence: 2026-09-25 06:30:13 source ERROR ErrorListingFiles ... botocore ClientError InvalidAccessKeyId on ListObjectsV2; SchemaInferenceError for customer_master, invoice_header, entity_attr_value

diagnosis.terraform_plan_before_reimport: No changes (provider keeps prior state for masked credentials; drift invisible)
diagnosis.terraform_plan_after_reimport: airbyte_source_s3.billing_landing update in-place, configuration re-sent, credentials (sensitive value); Plan: 0 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy
diagnosis.root_cause: Source credentials changed outside Terraform; live source no longer matched aws_iam_access_key.airbyte_reader.

repair.method: terraform state rm + import airbyte_source_s3.billing_landing, then apply -target=airbyte_source_s3.billing_landing -target=airbyte_connection.billing (make tp-airbyte-repair)

unverified: Failure email/Slack alert delivery was not observed.
The repair path was exercised once against the demo namespace only.
